content.title: Everything We Know About ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’
content.text: Skip to main content Everything We Know About ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’ Meryl Streep (wearing a coat by Fendi) in 'The Devil Wears Prada' (2006) 20th Century Fox Film Corp A sequel to The Devil Wears Prada is coming very soon, first revealed in July 2024, so best prepare and gird your loins. The original film was based on Lauren Weisberger’s 2003 novel of the same name, following Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway), a journalism graduate who moved to New York City and lands a very demanding job as junior assistant to Meryl Streep’s Miranda Priestly, editor-in-chief of Runway, a high-fashion magazine. Related Stories For everything we know about The Devil Wears Prada 2, read on below: Watch on Deadline When will The Devil Wears Prada 2 come out? The fashion sequel film will hit theaters on May 1, 2026, the original release date for Marvel’s Avengers: Doomsday. ‘The Devil Wears Prada,’Meryl Streep, 2006 20th Century Fox Film Corp Who will be in The Devil Wears Prada 2? Core four stars Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci are officially returning for the sequel. Kenneth Branagh will join to portray the husband of Streep’s character Miranda Priestly, an intense fashion magazine editor. RELATED: ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’: Kenneth Branagh Joins Sequel With Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt & Stanley Tucci Officially Back Deadline exclusively broke the news of Simone Ashley’s casting in the second film. Variety exclusively reported the casting of Lucy Liu, Justin Theroux, B.J. Novak and Pauline Chalamet. Entertainment Weekly broke the news that Sydney Sweeney’s cameo has been cut from the film. Deadline also exclusively reported that Rachel Bloom and Patrick Brammall have joined the sequel. Tracie Thoms and Tibor Feldman will also reprise their roles from the original. Lady Gaga, who has an original song titled “Runway” with Doechii in the film as unveiled in the third and final trailer, will appear in the movie as well. What will The Devil Wears Prada 2 be about? The film is expected to feature Miranda Priestly’s (Meryl Streep) perspective as the fierce editor-in-chief facing the decline of the print industry. As of the final trailer, it seems a scandal involving Runway magazine is afoot, and Andy has been recruited as a new features editor to help steer away from that. Who else is behind The Devil Wears Prada 2? Aline Brosh McKenna, the scribe behind the first film, will return to pen the screenplay for the sequel. When Deadline first confirmed the sequel in development, we were told that the original film’s director David Frankel was in talks to return as well, and that original producer Wendy Finerman would also be back. Is there a trailer for The Devil Wears Prada 2? A small teaser trailer was released Nov. 12. A full teaser was released Jan. 31 during the 2026 Grammy Awards. The third and final trailer arrived April 6.
